001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 * More efficient than the provided PropAllEqual.
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropSetEqual extends Propagator<SetVar> {
018
019    private final SetVar s1, s2;
020    private final ISetDeltaMonitor s1D, s2D;
021
022    public PropSetEqual(SetVar s1, SetVar s2) {
023        super(new SetVar[]{s1, s2}, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
024        this.s1 = s1;
025        this.s1D = s1.monitorDelta(this);
026        this.s2 = s2;
027        this.s2D = s2.monitorDelta(this);
028    }
029
030    private boolean isS1Var(int idx) {
031        return idx == 0;
032    }
033
034    private boolean isS2Var(int idx) {
035        return idx == 1;
036    }
037
038    @Override
039    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
040        return SetEventType.all();
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
045        PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(s1, s2, this);
046        PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(s2, s1, this);
047        PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(s1, s2, this);
048        PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(s2, s1, this);
049        s1D.startMonitoring();
050        s2D.startMonitoring();
051    }
052
053    @Override
054    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
055        if (isS1Var(idxVarInProp)) {
056            s1D.forEach(s1Env -> s2.remove(s1Env, this), SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
057            s1D.forEach(s1Ker -> s2.force(s1Ker, this), SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
058        } else {
059            assert isS2Var(idxVarInProp);
060            s2D.forEach(s2Env -> s1.remove(s2Env, this), SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
061            s2D.forEach(s2Ker -> s1.force(s2Ker, this), SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
062        }
063    }
064
065    @Override
066    public ESat isEntailed() {
067        if (!PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(s1, s2) || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(s2, s1)) {
068            return ESat.FALSE;
069        }
070        if (s1.isInstantiated() && s2.isInstantiated()) {
071            return ESat.TRUE;
072        }
073        int setIntersection = 0;
074        ISetIterator iter = s1.getUB().iterator();
075        while (iter.hasNext()) {
076            int i = iter.nextInt();
077            if (s2.getUB().contains(i)) {
078                setIntersection++;
079            }
080        }
081        if (setIntersection < s1.getCard().getLB() || setIntersection < s2.getCard().getLB()) {
082            return ESat.FALSE;
083        }
084
085        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
086    }
087
088    @Override
089    public String toString() {
090        return s1 + " = " + s2;
091    }
092}
